mediaWork.title: Beyond Innocence: The Life Sentence of Darryl Hunt
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The story of Darryl Hunt's wrongful conviction, his eventual exoneration, and the lasting trauma and challenges he faced after release
mediaWork.summaryNotes: "Beyond Innocence: The Life Sentence of Darryl Hunt" goes beyond the typical wrongful conviction narrative that ends with exoneration and freedom.  Author Phoebe Zerwick explores the lasting trauma and challenges Darryl Hunt faced after his release from prison, where he spent 19 years for a crime he did not commit.  The book details his struggles with the psychological effects of wrongful imprisonment and systemic racism, even after his exoneration in 2004 through DNA evidence. Despite founding the Darryl Hunt Project for Freedom and Justice, Hunt tragically committed suicide in 2016. The book uses Hunt's journals and interviews to provide a comprehensive portrait of his life and struggles, highlighting the ongoing challenges faced by exonerees.
